package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

func (runtime *Runtime) Submit(ctx context.Context, command domain.SubmitCommand) (domain.Submission, int, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeSubmitCommand(command)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, 0, err
	}
	digest, err := domain.CommandDigest(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, 0, err
	}
	unlock := runtime.lockInstance(normalized.TaskInstanceID)
	defer unlock()

	instance, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstance(ctx, normalized.StudentID, normalized.TaskInstanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	intent, err := runtime.Repository.GetIntent(ctx, normalized.TaskInstanceID, normalized.IdempotencyKey)
	if err == nil {
		if intent.StudentID != normalized.StudentID || intent.CommandDigest != digest || intent.Scope != normalized.Scope || intent.MilestoneID != normalized.MilestoneID {
			return domain.Submission{}, 409, domain.ErrIdempotency
		}
		if intent.Status == "COMMITTED" {
			submission, readErr := runtime.Repository.GetSubmission(ctx, intent.TaskInstanceID, intent.SubmissionID)
			if readErr != nil {
				return domain.Submission{}, statusFor(readErr), readErr
			}
			return submission.PublicProjection(), 202, nil
		}
		return runtime.resumeSubmit(ctx, instance, intent)
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.Submission{}, 503, err
	}
	if instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInProgress {
		return domain.Submission{}, 409, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if err := validateSubmissionScope(instance, normalized.Scope, normalized.MilestoneID); err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	specification, contractDigest, err := domain.BuildValidationSpecification(instance, normalized.Scope, normalized.MilestoneID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	specJSON, err := json.Marshal(specification)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, 503, err
	}
	submissionID, runID := runtime.newID(), runtime.newID()
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(submissionID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(runID) || submissionID == runID {
		return domain.Submission{}, 503, fmt.Errorf("invalid generated submission or validation-run identity")
	}
	intent = domain.SubmitIntent{TaskInstanceID: instance.ID, StudentID: instance.StudentID,
		IdempotencyKey: normalized.IdempotencyKey, CommandDigest: digest, SubmissionID: submissionID,
		ValidationRunID: runID, Scope: normalized.Scope, MilestoneID: normalized.MilestoneID,
		ValidationContractDigest: contractDigest, ValidationSpecification: specJSON, Status: "INTENT", CreatedAt: runtime.now()}
	stored, _, err := runtime.Repository.CreateOrLoadIntent(ctx, intent)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	if stored.StudentID != intent.StudentID || stored.CommandDigest != intent.CommandDigest || stored.Scope != intent.Scope || stored.MilestoneID != intent.MilestoneID {
		return domain.Submission{}, 409, domain.ErrIdempotency
	}
	return runtime.resumeSubmit(ctx, instance, stored)
}

func (runtime *Runtime) resumeSubmit(ctx context.Context, instance domain.TaskInstance, intent domain.SubmitIntent) (domain.Submission, int, error) {
	if intent.Status == "COMMITTED" {
		submission, err := runtime.Repository.GetSubmission(ctx, intent.TaskInstanceID, intent.SubmissionID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.Submission{}, statusFor(err), err
		}
		return submission.PublicProjection(), 202, nil
	}
	if instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInProgress || intent.Status == "ABORTED" {
		return domain.Submission{}, 409, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if intent.TaskInstanceID != instance.ID || intent.StudentID != instance.StudentID || intent.SubmissionID == "" || intent.ValidationRunID == "" {
		return domain.Submission{}, 503, domain.ErrDependency
	}
	if intent.WriteLockID == "" {
		writeLock, err := runtime.Workspace.LockWrites(ctx, ports.LockWorkspaceWrites{SandboxID: instance.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID,
			RequestID: intent.SubmissionID, Mode: "TEMPORARY", SubmissionID: intent.SubmissionID})
		if err != nil || writeLock.LockID == "" || writeLock.FenceEpoch <= 0 || writeLock.Permanent {
			return domain.Submission{}, 503, domain.ErrDependency
		}
		intent.WriteLockID, intent.FenceEpoch, intent.Status = writeLock.LockID, writeLock.FenceEpoch, "LOCKED"
		if err := runtime.Repository.SaveIntent(ctx, intent); err != nil {
			return domain.Submission{}, 503, err
		}
	}
	if intent.Snapshot.SnapshotID == "" {
		snapshot, err := runtime.Workspace.FreezeSnapshot(ctx, ports.FreezeSnapshot{SandboxID: instance.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID,
			SubmissionID: intent.SubmissionID, TaskInstanceID: instance.ID})
		if err != nil || !validSnapshot(snapshot, instance.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID) {
			return domain.Submission{}, 503, domain.ErrDependency
		}
		intent.Snapshot, intent.Status = snapshot, "FROZEN"
		if err := runtime.Repository.SaveIntent(ctx, intent); err != nil {
			return domain.Submission{}, 503, err
		}
	}
	if !validSnapshot(intent.Snapshot, instance.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID) {
		return domain.Submission{}, 503, domain.ErrDependency
	}
	pinned, err := runtime.Workspace.ReadPinnedSnapshot(ctx, intent.Snapshot)
	if err != nil || pinned.Ref != intent.Snapshot {
		return domain.Submission{}, 503, domain.ErrDependency
	}
	now := runtime.now()
	run := domain.ValidationRun{ID: intent.ValidationRunID, Status: domain.ValidationRunPending}
	submission := domain.Submission{Schema: domain.SubmissionSchema, ID: intent.SubmissionID, TaskInstanceID: instance.ID,
		StudentID: instance.StudentID, Scope: intent.Scope, MilestoneID: intent.MilestoneID, Snapshot: intent.Snapshot,
		WorkspaceDigest: intent.Snapshot.WorkspaceDigest, Status: domain.SubmissionValidating, ValidationRuns: []domain.ValidationRun{run},
		CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, ValidationSpecification: append([]byte(nil), intent.ValidationSpecification...),
		ValidationContractDigest: intent.ValidationContractDigest, RevisionDigest: instance.TaskRevisionDigest,
		RequiresHumanReview: instance.ReviewRequired, IdempotencyKey: intent.IdempotencyKey, CommandDigest: intent.CommandDigest}
	intent.Status = "COMMITTED"
	if err := runtime.Repository.CommitIntent(ctx, intent, submission, run); err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	return submission.PublicProjection(), 202, nil
}

func validateSubmissionScope(instance domain.TaskInstance, scope, milestoneID string) error {
	switch scope {
	case "FINAL":
		for _, step := range instance.Steps {
			if step.Required && step.Status != "PASSED" && step.Status != "CHECKPOINTED" {
				return domain.ErrConflict
			}
		}
		return nil
	case "MILESTONE":
		for _, step := range instance.Steps {
			if !step.Required || step.Status == "PASSED" || step.Status == "CHECKPOINTED" {
				continue
			}
			if step.ID != milestoneID {
				return domain.ErrConflict
			}
			if step.Status != "AVAILABLE" {
				return domain.ErrConflict
			}
			return nil
		}
	}
	return domain.ErrConflict
}

func validSnapshot(snapshot domain.SnapshotRef, sandboxID string) bool {
	if sandboxID == "" || snapshot.SandboxID != sandboxID || snapshot.SnapshotID == "" || snapshot.GenerationID == "" || !strings.HasPrefix(snapshot.WorkspaceDigest, "sha256:") {
		return false
	}
	digest, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(snapshot.WorkspaceDigest, "sha256:"))
	return err == nil && len(digest) == 32
}
